messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@sycamorehealth.com>, Evan Liu <evan.liu@sycamorehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Sycamore pilot: agreed milestones, owners, and next steps

Hi Maya / Evan —

Thanks again for the 45m today. Quick recap from my side so we have a single source of truth and can align stakeholders. Please confirm or correct anything below.

High-level pain and goals
- Pain: Search returns are inconsistent for patient-facing knowledge base; agents are spending 20–30% more time in manual lookups.
- Goal: Reduce agent lookup time by 40% and increase average first-contact resolution for knowledge queries within 90 days of pilot.

Proposed pilot scope (what we covered)
- Phase 0 (week 1–2): Data inventory + connectivity proof (S3 + internal docs). Owner: Evan (Sycamore) + Monica (Redwood)
- Phase 1 (week 3–6): Inference pilot — integrate Redwood API with routing rules and measure latency/cost. Owner: Evan + Karthik
- Phase 2 (week 7–12): Quality tuning, prompt sets, and A/B with 2000 real queries. Owner: Monica + Sycamore analytics
- Success criteria: 40% agent time reduction; <500ms 95th percentile latency for search path; produce evaluation report at end of Phase 2.

Decision process & stakeholders
- Technical signoff: Evan Liu (Sycamore Eng) and Monica (Redwood CS)
- Procurement / commercial: Maya Thompson (Sycamore Procurement) — SOC2 + contract review required
- Executive sponsor: Sarah Kaplan (Sycamore VP Ops) — final approval for pilot budget

Key dates we agreed (please confirm)
- Data access & security questionnaire returned: target Sep 29
- Connectivity proof complete: Oct 6
- Pilot start (inference enabled): Oct 10
- Pilot evaluation report: Nov 21

Open actions (owners + due)
- Maya: share procurement timeline and any vendor PO process (due Sep 27)
- Evan: provide a list of data buckets and tech contact for S3 access (due Sep 29)
- Monica: finalize test plan and send Redwood access instructions (due Oct 1)
- Ben: prepare preliminary pilot commercial worksheet (cost estimate + optional burst capacity) and share by Oct 3

Attachments I am pushing to Drive now: 20270922_sycamore_map_v1.pdf (draft MAP) and a short security checklist. I'll upload the security questionnaire as a spreadsheet once we confirm the tech contact.

Next steps
- Please reply to confirm owners & dates above. If those dates look tight from procurement side, tell us what would be realistic.
- I'll set a 30-minute kickoff on Oct 6 for the connectivity proof once we have data contact info.

Thanks — appreciated the clarity from your team on priorities.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kal +1 (415) 555-0198

Karthik —

Thanks for the concise recap and the suggested timeline. Confirming the high-level plan looks good. A few notes from procurement/ops side: 

1) Procurement timeline: We typically take 10–14 business days for contract review and vendor onboarding. I'll try to expedite but realistic target for completed paperwork is Oct 11 unless you can provide SOC2 and a standard MSA earlier.
2) Security questionnaire: Evan will be our tech lead and will fill out the questionnaire — Evan, I'll share the form.
3) PO process: We need an MSA + SOW. Once terms are OK, we can issue a PO.

Also, small update on dates based on procurement:
- Security questionnaire returned: target Sep 30 (we'll try for Sep 29)
- Connectivity proof (internal): Oct 8 (we push date one business day)
- Pilot start: Oct 12

I'll add Sarah to the loop once we have the SOW draft.

Attaching: procurement checklist (referenced).

Best,
Maya Thompson
